acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Gel-based experiment; Bottom-up proteomics; Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were in-gel digested with trypsin and desalted as described in https://doi.org/10.1021/pr500164j.

collision_energy.evidence: For MS/MS peptides were selected for a 1 s time window in between master scans in a data-dependent mode with HCD at 30% NCE, to be detected in the Orbitrap with a resolution of 30000.

enrichment_method.evidence: The aim of this experiment was to compare affinity enrichment of ADP-ribosylated Arabidopsis thaliana proteins using the enhanced Af1521 Macro domain versus a G42E mutant variant as control.

fragmentation_method.evidence: For MS/MS peptides were selected for a 1 s time window in between master scans in a data-dependent mode with HCD at 30% NCE, to be detected in the Orbitrap with a resolution of 30000.

ionization_type.evidence: Eluted peptides were electrosprayed on-line into the Fusion Lumos Tribrid with a spray voltage of 2.0 kV and capillary temperature of 305°C.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Peptides (MS1) were detected in the Orbitrap with the following settings: resolving power: 120,000; scan range m/z 300–1500; S-Lens RF 30%; AGC target Standard, max injection time (IT) on Auto mode, microscans: 1.

ptm.evidence: Carbamidomethylation of cysteine (C) was set as fixed modification.

Variable modifications were oxidation of methionine (M), acetylated protein N-termini and ADP-ribosylation of aspartic acid (D), glutamic acid (E), asparagine (N), glutamine (Q), lysine (K), arginine (R), serine (S), cysteine (C), and histidine (H).

reduction_concentration.evidence: Protein extracts were prepared by grinding plant leaf material in liquid N2 to a fine powder followed by resuspension in extraction buffer [50 mM Tris-HCl, 150 mM NaCl, 10% (v/v) glycerol, 1 mM EDTA, 5 mM DTT, 1× protease inhibitor cocktail (Sigma-Aldrich #P9599), 10 uM MG132 (Merck), 0.2% NP 40, pH 7.4] at a ratio of 2 mL buffer per 1 g leaf material.
